hypothesis: E003's edge failure is systematic across both held-out edge Reynolds groups and is associated with material BatchNorm running-state adaptation despite comparatively conservative global trainable-parameter movement.
scope: Saved-artifact analysis only: no training, model construction, model forward, or new validation inference.
analyses: official quality metrics by stratum, nominal Reynolds number, and angle of attack
relative-L2 error by forecast lead and window start
target/prediction channel moments and target zero fractions by Reynolds number
initial-to-final trainable-parameter and BatchNorm running-state drift

decision_rule.if_all_hold: Pre-register one isolated BatchNorm-running-state freeze ablation before changing normalization or sampling.
decision_rule.otherwise: Do not prioritize BatchNorm freezing; use the per-regime diagnostics to choose a normalization or sampling hypothesis.

limitations: This post-hoc analysis can identify associations but cannot establish that BatchNorm drift caused the OOD failure.
Further reuse of E002 validation diagnostics increases model-selection pressure on the frozen split and must be recorded.
